meta.description: Source policy registry for Achiote reference pantry and cache-warming fixtures

notes: This registry controls which public data sources may be used for typed pantry fixtures.
It is a legal and quality gate, not a claim that the server performs source access itself.

sources.label: Wikidata structured food data
allowedUses: structured labels, aliases, item identifiers, and high-level statements
cross-language name discovery and transliteration clues
candidate generation that remains marked as source_researched or uncertain
disallowedUses: article prose from Wikipedia or other non-CC0 namespaces
uncited cultural interpretation beyond the structured statements
treating country-of-origin statements as family-specific certainty
operatorNotes: Prefer Wikidata as the first source for high-frequency names because the structured data is CC0.
Record item identifiers or stable URLs in ResearchRecord sources.

sources.label: USDA FoodData Central
allowedUses: source metadata for public-domain nutrient or composition records
disallowedUses: storing API keys or request credentials in fixtures
operatorNotes: Use for ingredient grounding, not as an authority on cultural memory.
List FoodData Central as a source when its data is used.

sources.label: Open Food Facts product database
allowedUses: operator-reviewed package label facts when attribution and share-alike obligations are acceptable
ingredient label variants for diaspora grocery products
barcode-linked source metadata when a product clue matters
disallowedUses: product images or contributor photos without separate rights review
using packaged products as cultural authority for a whole foodway
operatorNotes: Default to manual review because ODbL has attribution and share-alike obligations.
Prefer CC0/public-domain sources when they answer the same question.

sources.label: FAO/INFOODS food composition databases

license.name: FAO terms require operator review before redistribution

allowedUses: region-specific ingredient composition context after license review
disallowedUses: copying table rows into fixtures without license approval
operatorNotes: Useful for global breadth, especially underrepresented regions, but do not auto-ingest.
Treat as a source discovery and review target until redistribution terms are recorded.

disallowedPatterns: copied recipe instructions or article prose
proprietary food guides or ranking databases
paywalled or access-restricted databases without explicit rights
raw user memories, prompts, credentials, or provider diagnostics
